lookahead.vnd.controls.title: Indicators of the controls of contractors
lookahead.vnd.controls.label: Indicators of the controls of contractors: independence checks, risk grades, performance, bid security, subcontractor payments
lookahead.vnd.controls.empty: No indicator is registered in the register of metric definitions yet.
lookahead.vnd.controls.error: The indicators of the controls of contractors could not be loaded.
lookahead.vnd.controls.hidden: These indicators count over the whole tenant, so they need the right over the whole tenant; your account holds rights in a narrower scope.
lookahead.vnd.duplicates.title: Suggested duplicate contractors of the whole register
lookahead.vnd.duplicates.note: A duplicate is only a suggestion from the tax code, address, phone, representative, owner and account. Nothing is merged here: a suggestion is dismissed, or sent to the merge of master data, and both keep a reason.
lookahead.vnd.duplicates.empty: There is no suggested duplicate in this state.
lookahead.vnd.duplicates.error: The list of suggested duplicates could not be loaded.
lookahead.vnd.duplicates.hidden: You do not have the right to see the suggested duplicates of the whole register.
lookahead.vnd.duplicates.receipt: The decision on the suggested duplicate is recorded.
lookahead.vnd.trace.title: Record the submission trace of a proposal
lookahead.vnd.trace.note: Recorded once for each proposal and never rewritten. The server keeps only hashes of the origin, the device and the file authors: no address, device or name is stored in a readable form. At least one fact is needed.
lookahead.vnd.trace.proposal.label: Proposal identifier
lookahead.vnd.trace.proposal.hint: The identifier of the proposal you received.
lookahead.vnd.trace.origin.label: Origin of the submission (network address or place)
lookahead.vnd.trace.device.label: Device of the submission
lookahead.vnd.trace.agent.label: Program used to submit
lookahead.vnd.trace.submittedAt.label: Day of submission (Vietnam time)
lookahead.vnd.trace.files.label: Files of the proposal
lookahead.vnd.trace.files.hint: Each file needs the identifier of a document version that belongs to this proposal; do not enter a version twice.
lookahead.vnd.trace.file.author: Author written in the file
lookahead.vnd.trace.error.exists: This proposal already has a submission trace; a trace is recorded once and never rewritten.
lookahead.vnd.trace.receipt: The submission trace of the proposal is recorded.
lookahead.vnd.trace.submittedAt.hint: The time of submission is recorded only when both the day and the time are given; a day alone is not sent, so the real submission time of the proposal stays as it is.
lookahead.vnd.trace.submittedTime.label: Time of submission (hours:minutes, Vietnam time)
lookahead.vnd.trace.submittedTime.hint: Like 14:30. Needs the day of submission with it.
